summary.text: Greg Ford is a Republican state representative from Dorchester County who represents South Carolina House District 98 after winning a January 6, 2026 special election, and he is seeking a full term on November 3, 2026.
A retired Air Force veteran, he faces Democrat Sonja Ogletree Satani in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Greg Ford was born in Charlotte, North Carolina, and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1997 to 2017, according to the House member page and Ballotpedia.
He earned a B.S. from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in 2010 and an M.S. from The Citadel in 2018, and the page says he is enrolled in a doctoral program at Charleston Southern University.

The House member page says Ford was elected on January 6, 2026, to fill the unexpired term of Christopher J. Murphy, who resigned, and lists his committee assignment as Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey for an earlier campaign, Ford named taxation, managed development within the district and county, and education among his key messages, and said he wanted to eliminate the state income tax.
